title: Refactor cdev dispatch: all paths through ops vtable
description:
Update crypto2dev_cdev.c and crypto2dev_fd.c so write(), read(), and all ioctls dispatch through ops->* callbacks.

- Remove all direct wolfCrypt calls from cdev layer
- crypto2dev_fips_gate() removed from framework; framework calls ops->fips_gate() before sess_init if non-NULL
- write() -> ops->update()
- read() -> ops->finalize()
- SET_IV -> ops->set_iv()
- SET_AAD -> ops->set_aad()
- GET_TAG -> ops->get_tag()
- SET_TAG -> ops->set_tag()
- STATUS ioctl: enumerate registered providers/algos instead of hardcoded wolfCrypt list

Depends on: registry issue, fd_state refactor issue
